description: Scala source code defining the DataFrameWriterV2 class for writing Spark DataFrames to external storage using the v2 API, including methods for configuration and execution of write operations.

classes.name: DataFrameWriterV2
classes.description: A class providing methods to configure and execute write operations for Spark DataFrames using the v2 API.

methods.name: using
methods.description: Sets the data source provider for the write operation.

methods.description: Adds a key-value option for the write operation.

methods.name: options

methods.name: tableProperty

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Specifies columns to cluster the data by.

methods.description: Creates a new table with the data.
